en.s: The siege of Antioch was a military engagement between the Seljuks of Rum led by Sulieman ibn Qutalmish and the Byzantine garrison of Philaretos. The Seljuk with a small force managed to capture the city in late 1084 while the castle surrendered in early 1085.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 安条克围城战发生在苏莱曼·伊本·库塔尔米什率领的罗姆塞尔柱军队与菲拉雷托斯麾下的拜占庭驻军之间。塞尔柱军队以一支小部队于1084年末攻占安条克城，城堡则在1085年初投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Epiphany was a naval battle fought on 5–6 January or 12 January 1156, between the Norse Godred Olafsson (Godred the Black), King of the Isles and the Norse-Gaelic Somhairle MacGillebride (Somerled), King of Cinn Tìre (Kintyre), Argyll and Lorne, off the coast of Islay, Scotland.

zh.s: 1156年1月5日至6日，或另一说1月12日，苏格兰艾莱岛近海爆发主显节海战。双方是挪威裔的群岛国王戈德雷德·奥拉夫松，又称“黑戈德雷德”，与挪威—盖尔裔的萨默莱德，后者统治琴泰、阿盖尔及洛恩。

en.t: Coronation of Gustav I of Sweden
en.s: Gustav I of Sweden was crowned on 12 January 1528. He had already been elected king in June 1523; the coronation was a later ceremony, rather than the beginning of his reign.

zh.t: 瑞典国王古斯塔夫一世加冕
zh.s: 1528年1月12日，瑞典国王古斯塔夫一世举行加冕仪式。他早在1523年6月就已当选国王，因此这次加冕是后续仪式，并非其统治的开始。

en.s: Bayinnaung was formally crowned king at Pegu on 12 January 1554, taking the reign name Thiri Thudhamma Yaza. His chief queen, Thakin Gyi, was crowned with the reign name Agga Mahethi.

zh.s: 1554年1月12日，莽应龙在勃固正式加冕为王，采用王号Thiri Thudhamma Yaza。其正宫王后德钦基同时加冕，采用王后尊号Agga Mahethi。

en.s: On January 12, 1616, Portuguese captain Francisco Caldeira Castelo Branco anchored in what is now Guajará Bay. He built the wooden fort Presépio, now known as Forte do Castelo. The settlement that developed around the fort became the city of Belém.

zh.s: 1616年1月12日，葡萄牙船长弗朗西斯科·卡尔代拉·卡斯特洛·布兰科在如今的瓜雅拉湾抛锚。他建造了名为“圣诞马槽”的木制堡垒，即今天的城堡要塞。堡垒周围逐渐形成聚落，后来发展为贝伦城。

en.t: Thomas Pinckney appointed minister to Britain
en.s: Thomas Pinckney was appointed United States minister plenipotentiary to Great Britain on January 12, 1792. He presented his credentials on August 9, 1792. The appointment date was distinct from the start of his diplomatic service in Britain.

zh.t: 托马斯·平克尼获任美国驻英公使
zh.s: 1792年1月12日，托马斯·平克尼获任美国驻英国全权公使。他于同年8月9日递交国书，因此获任日期与在英国正式履职的时间应当区分。

en.t: Decision to demolish St Mary’s Church, Reculver
en.s: At a parish vestry meeting on 12 January 1808, a decision was made to demolish St Mary’s Church at Reculver after coastal erosion threatened the building. This was the decision to demolish the church, not the date the demolition work began. The demolition took place later, in 1809.

zh.t: 雷卡尔弗圣玛丽教堂拆除决定
zh.s: 1808年1月12日，因海岸侵蚀威胁建筑安全，雷卡尔弗教区会议决定拆除圣玛丽教堂。当天作出的是拆除决定，并未立即开始拆除施工；实际拆除发生在1809年。

en.s: The Battle of Casma was a naval confrontation that occurred on 12 January 1839 during the War of the Confederation between Chile and the Peru–Bolivian Confederation. The battle took place in the bay of Casma, located off the Peruvian coast, 370 kilometers north of Callao. Although both sides claimed victory, in reality the three Chilean Navy ships, commanded by Roberto Simpson, defeated the four privateer vessels fighting on behalf of the Confederation.

zh.s: 1839年1月12日，邦联战争期间，智利与秘鲁—玻利维亚邦联在秘鲁海岸外的卡斯马湾交战，战场位于卡亚俄以北约370公里处。尽管双方都宣称获胜，实际上，罗伯托·辛普森率领的3艘智利海军舰艇击败了代表邦联作战的4艘私掠船。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 1847 Hamilton municipal election was the first election held to the newly incorporated Town of Hamilton. The vote was held on January 12, 1847 to select ten members to represent each of the city's five wards on the Hamilton, Ontario, City Council. Those councillors would, in turn, elect one mayor from their ranks and an additional councillor to represent the seat they vacated on Saturday, January 16, 1847.

zh.t: 1847年加拿大汉密尔顿首届市政选举
zh.s: 1847年1月12日，安大略省新近建制的汉密尔顿镇举行首次市政选举，选出十名议员，代表五个选区。随后，这些议员于1月16日星期六从中选出一名市长，并再选一名议员填补市长留下的议席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Sicilian revolution of independence of 1848 occurred in a year replete with revolutions and popular revolts. It commenced on 12 January 1848, and therefore was the very first of the numerous revolutions to occur that year. Three revolutions had previously occurred on the island of Sicily starting from 1800 against Bourbon rule: this final one resulted in an independent state surviving for 16 months. The constitution that survived the 16 months was quite advanced for its time in liberal democratic terms, as was the proposal of an Italian confederation of states.

zh.s: 1848年1月12日，西西里爆发独立革命，是这一革命与民众起义频繁年份中最先发生的一场革命。自1800年起，西西里岛此前已发生三次反抗波旁王朝统治的革命；这最后一次建立了一个维持16个月的独立国家。其宪法在当时的自由民主观念下颇为先进，提出建立意大利各邦联邦的主张也同样如此。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1851–52 Massachusetts gubernatorial election consisted of an initial popular vote held on November 10, 1851, followed by a legislative vote conducted on January 12, 1852. Incumbent Democrat Governor George S. Boutwell was reelected to a second term in office. The ultimate task of electing the governor had been placed before the Massachusetts General Court because no candidate received the majority of the vote required for a candidate to be elected through the popular election.
en.n: This entry records the legislative, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1851—1852年马萨诸塞州州长选举先于1851年11月10日举行民众投票，再于1852年1月12日由州议会投票。现任民主党州长乔治·S.鲍特韦尔获连任，开始第二个任期。由于民众投票中没有候选人获得当选所需的过半数选票，最终由马萨诸塞州议会选出州长。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的州议会投票日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1852–53 Massachusetts gubernatorial election consisted of an initial popular vote held on November 8, 1852, followed by a legislative vote conducted on January 12, 1853, which elected Whig Party nominee John H. Clifford. The ultimate task of electing the governor had been placed before the Massachusetts General Court because no candidate received the majority of the vote required for a candidate to be elected through the popular election.
en.n: This entry records the legislative, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1852—1853年马萨诸塞州州长选举先于1852年11月8日举行民众投票，再于1853年1月12日由州议会投票，选出辉格党候选人约翰·H.克利福德。由于民众投票中没有候选人获得当选所需的过半数选票，最终由马萨诸塞州议会选出州长。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的州议会投票日期。

en.t: Founding of the Aeronautical Society of Great Britain
en.s: The Aeronautical Society of Great Britain, now the Royal Aeronautical Society, was formed at a meeting at Argyll Lodge, Campden Hill, London, on 12 January 1866. The Duke of Argyll presided. The Society’s first public meeting followed on 27 June 1866; this was separate from its founding meeting.

zh.s: 1866年1月12日，英国航空学会在伦敦坎普登山的阿盖尔府召开会议并成立，由阿盖尔公爵主持。该学会后来成为英国皇家航空学会。首场公开会议于同年6月27日举行，与1月的成立会议是两次不同的会议。

en.s: The Battle of Le Mans was a German victory during the Franco-Prussian War that ended French resistance in western France.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 勒芒战役是普法战争中德军取得的一次胜利，结束了法国在其西部地区的抵抗。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Yohannes IV was crowned Emperor of Ethiopia on 12 January 1872. His coronation was held at Axum. He ruled as emperor until his death in 1889.

zh.s: 1872年1月12日，约翰内斯四世在阿克苏姆加冕为埃塞俄比亚皇帝。他一直统治到1889年去世。

en.s: The 1874–75 New South Wales colonial election was held between 8 December 1874 and 12 January 1875. This election was for all of the 72 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 52 single-member constituencies, six 2-member constituencies and two 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1874—1875年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举
zh.s: 1874—1875年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举于1874年12月8日至1875年1月12日举行，改选立法议会全部72个席位。选区包括52个单席选区、6个双席选区和2个四席选区，均采用相对多数制。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 12 January 1879 action at Sihayo's kraal was an early skirmish in the Anglo-Zulu War. The day after launching an invasion of Zululand, the British Lieutenant-General Lord Chelmsford led a reconnaissance in force against the kraal of Zulu Chief Sihayo kaXongo. This was intended to secure his left flank for an advance on the Zulu capital at Ulundi and as retribution against Sihayo for the incursion of his sons into the neighbouring British Colony of Natal.

zh.s: 1879年1月12日，英祖战争初期，英军与祖鲁武装在西哈约的村落交战。入侵祖鲁兰的次日，切姆斯福德勋爵中将率部向祖鲁首领西哈约·卡雄戈的村落展开武装侦察，目的是确保向祖鲁都城乌伦迪推进时的左翼安全，同时报复西哈约的儿子们越境进入邻近的英国纳塔尔殖民地。

en.t: 1881 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1881 United States Senate election in California was held on January 12, 1881, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. Republican Union Army General John Franklin Miller was elected over Democratic California chief justice William T. Wallace.

zh.t: 1881年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1881年1月12日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出该州第一组参议员席位的代表。共和党籍联邦军将军约翰·富兰克林·米勒，击败民主党籍加州首席大法官威廉·T.华莱士当选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The National Trust was incorporated in the United Kingdom on 12 January 1895 as the National Trust for Places of Historic Interest or Natural Beauty. Its founders were social reformer Octavia Hill, solicitor Robert Hunter and clergyman Hardwicke Rawnsley. The organisation was established to preserve places of natural beauty or historic interest for the benefit of the nation.

zh.t: 英国国民信托正式注册成立
zh.s: 1895年1月12日，英国国民信托以“历史名胜或自然美景国民信托”的名称正式注册成立。创办者是社会改革家奥克塔维娅·希尔、律师罗伯特·亨特和牧师哈德威克·罗恩斯利。该机构旨在为公众保存具有自然美景或历史价值的地方。

en.t: 1897 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1897 United States Senate election in California was held on January 12, 1897, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. Incumbent Republican Senator George Clement Perkins was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating several Democratic and Populist challengers.

zh.t: 1897年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1897年1月12日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，改选该州第三组参议员席位。共和党籍现任参议员乔治·克莱门特·珀金斯，击败数名民主党及人民党挑战者，获选第二个任期。

en.t: 1898 United States Senate elections in Ohio
en.s: On January 12, 1898, the Ohio General Assembly met in joint convention to elect a United States Senator. The incumbent, Mark Hanna, had been appointed by Governor Asa Bushnell on March 5, 1897, to fill the vacancy caused by the resignation of John Sherman to become Secretary of State to President (and former Ohio governor) William McKinley. Hanna's appointment was only good until the legislature met and made its own choice.

zh.t: 1898年美国俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1898年1月12日，俄亥俄州议会举行两院联席会议，选举联邦参议员。现任参议员马克·汉纳于1897年3月5日获州长阿萨·布什内尔任命，填补约翰·谢尔曼辞职后留下的空缺。谢尔曼转任威廉·麦金莱总统的国务卿，而麦金莱也曾任俄亥俄州州长。汉纳的任命只持续到州议会开会并自行选出参议员为止。

en.s: The 1905 Mile End by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 12 January 1905. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 1905年1月12日，英国迈尔恩德下议院选区举行补选。该选区采用得票最多者当选的制度，选出一名下议院议员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: A by-election was held for the New South Wales Legislative Assembly electorate of Blayney on 12 January 1907 after Paddy Crick resigned following corruption findings by a Royal Commission. Crick did not nominate for this by-election. His expulsion from the Assembly and return in a subsequent by-election referred to an earlier contest in West Macquarie in 1890.

zh.s: 帕迪·克里克因皇家委员会作出贪腐认定而辞去议员职务后，新南威尔士立法议会布莱尼选区于1907年1月12日举行补选。克里克没有参加这次补选。他遭议会开除后又在补选中重返议会，是1890年西麦夸里选区的往事，并非1907年这次补选的结果。

en.t: Newcastle United F.C. 0–1 Crystal Palace F.C. (1907)
en.s: Newcastle United v Crystal Palace was a football match played on 12 January 1907 at St James' Park, Newcastle. The match was an FA Cup First Round match. The result, a 1–0 victory for Crystal Palace, is notable for being one of the greatest shocks in the history of the FA Cup. The home team, Newcastle United, played in the Football League First Division, the highest level of English football at that time.

zh.t: 1907年水晶宫客场1比0击败纽卡斯尔联
zh.s: 1907年1月12日，纽卡斯尔联与水晶宫在纽卡斯尔圣詹姆斯公园球场进行足总杯首轮比赛。水晶宫以1比0取胜，被视为足总杯历史上最大的冷门之一。主队纽卡斯尔联当时参加英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛，即当时英格兰足球的最高级别联赛。

en.t: 1909 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1909 United States Senate election in California was held on January 12, 1909, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. Incumbent Republican Senator George Clement Perkins was re-elected to a fourth term in office with no serious opposition.

zh.t: 1909年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1909年1月12日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，改选该州第三组参议员席位。共和党籍现任参议员乔治·克莱门特·珀金斯没有遇到有力挑战，获选第四个任期。

en.t: Establishment of the University of the Philippines College of Law
en.s: The University of the Philippines formally established its College of Law on January 12, 1911. George Malcolm had proposed creating the school and arranged law classes at the Manila YMCA in 1910 after initial resistance from the university’s Board of Regents. The university subsequently adopted those classes when it established the college.

zh.t: 菲律宾大学法学院成立
zh.s: 1911年1月12日，菲律宾大学正式设立法学院。乔治·马尔科姆此前提出创办法学院，但最初遭到大学董事会反对，于是在1910年安排马尼拉基督教青年会开办法学课程。大学后来接受了这一方案，并在成立法学院时接办这些课程。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 12 January 1912. Although the Social Democratic Party (SPD) had received the most votes in every election since 1890, they had never won the most seats, and in the 1907 elections they had won fewer than half the seats of the Centre Party despite receiving over a million more votes. However, this election saw the party win more than double the number of votes of the second-placed Centre Party and become the largest party, winning 110 of the 397 seats.

zh.s: 1912年1月12日，德国举行国会选举。自1890年以来，社会民主党每次选举得票都最多，却从未赢得最多席位；1907年，它比中央党多获100多万票，席位却还不到中央党的一半。这次选举中，社民党的得票超过第二名中央党的两倍，并取得397席中的110席，终于成为国会最大党。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 12 January 1915. Carlos Meléndez Ramirez was the only candidate, and was elected unopposed.

zh.s: 1915年1月12日，萨尔瓦多举行总统选举。卡洛斯·梅伦德斯·拉米雷斯是唯一候选人，因无人竞争而当选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: U.S. House rejects a women’s suffrage amendment
en.s: On January 12, 1915, the United States House of Representatives voted on a federal constitutional amendment to give women the right to vote. The proposal was defeated, with 174 votes in favour and 204 against. This vote did not enact nationwide women’s suffrage.

zh.t: 美国众议院否决妇女选举权修宪提案
zh.s: 1915年1月12日，美国众议院就赋予妇女选举权的联邦宪法修正案进行表决。提案获得174票赞成、204票反对，未获通过。这次表决并未确立全国性的妇女选举权。

en.s: The Minnie Pit disaster was a coal mining accident that took place on 12 January 1918 in Halmer End, Staffordshire, in which 155 men and boys died. The disaster, which was caused by an explosion due to firedamp, is the worst ever recorded in the North Staffordshire Coalfield. An official investigation never established what caused the ignition of flammable gases in the pit.

zh.s: 1918年1月12日，英国斯塔福德郡哈尔默恩德的米妮煤矿发生瓦斯爆炸，155名成年及未成年男性矿工遇难。这是北斯塔福德郡煤田有记录以来最严重的矿难。官方调查始终未能确定，是什么点燃了矿井中的易燃气体。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.t: Japanese warship Iwami arrives at Vladivostok
en.s: The Japanese warship Iwami arrived at Vladivostok on 12 January 1918, two days before the British warship HMS Suffolk. The arrival was an early naval deployment in the context of Allied intervention in Siberia. It should not be confused with the later landing of Japanese ground forces.

zh.t: 日本军舰石见号抵达海参崴
zh.s: 1918年1月12日，日本军舰石见号抵达海参崴，比英国军舰萨福克号早两天。这是在协约国干涉西伯利亚背景下的一次早期海军部署，不应与日本陆军随后登陆的行动混为一谈。

en.s: The Spartacist uprising (German: Spartakusaufstand), also known as the January uprising (Januaraufstand) or, more rarely, Bloody Week, was an armed uprising that took place in Berlin from 5–12 January 1919. It occurred in connection with the German revolution that broke out just before the end of World War I.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1919年1月5日至12日，柏林爆发武装起义，史称斯巴达克起义，也称一月起义，较少情况下称“血腥周”。这场起义与第一次世界大战结束前爆发的德国革命有关。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Dover by-election of 1921 was held on 12 January 1921. The by-election was held due to the succession to the peerage of the incumbent Coalition Conservative MP, Vere Ponsonby as Ninth Earl of Bessborough. It was won by the Independent candidate Thomas Andrew Polson. Polson's election was supported by Horatio Bottomley, but although claimed by Bottonmley as a member of the right-wing Independent Parliamentary Group, he joined the Anti-Waste League shortly after his election. Polson stood again at the general election in November 1922, but was defeated by the Conservative candidate John Jacob Astor, whom he had defeated at the by-election in 1921.

zh.s: 1921年1月12日，英国多佛举行补选。支持联合政府的保守党现任议员维尔·庞森比继承第九代贝斯伯勒伯爵爵位，留下议席空缺。独立候选人托马斯·安德鲁·波尔森获胜，竞选得到霍雷肖·博特姆利支持。博特姆利宣称波尔森属于右翼的独立议会集团，但波尔森当选不久便加入反浪费联盟。1922年11月大选时，波尔森再度参选，却败给保守党候选人约翰·雅各布·阿斯特；阿斯特正是1921年补选时被他击败的对手。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Seamen's Strike of 1922 began on 12 January 1922, when Chinese seamen from Hong Kong and Canton (now Guangzhou) went on strike for higher wages. Led by the Seamen's Union after shipping companies refused to increase salaries by 40%, the strike quickly garnered over 30,000 participants, greatly disrupting everyday colonial life and food shipments to Hong Kong.

zh.s: 1922年1月12日，来自香港和广州的中国海员为争取加薪举行罢工。船运公司拒绝将工资提高40%后，海员工会领导罢工，参与人数很快超过3万人，严重影响了香港的殖民地日常生活及食品运输。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in two stages in Egypt in 1923 and 1924, the first since nominal independence from the United Kingdom in 1922. The result was a victory for the Wafd Party, which won 179 of the 211 seats.
en.n: This entry records the second stage, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 埃及于1923年和1924年分两个阶段举行议会选举。这是埃及1922年名义上脱离英国独立后的首次议会选举。华夫脱党获胜，取得211个席位中的179席。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二阶段投票日期。

en.t: Hattie Caraway becomes the first woman elected to the U.S. Senate
en.s: Hattie Caraway won a special election in Arkansas on January 12, 1932, becoming the first woman elected to the United States Senate. She had initially been appointed to fill the vacancy caused by her husband’s death in 1931. The January special election was distinct from her election to a full term later in 1932.

zh.t: 哈蒂·卡拉韦成为首位经选举产生的美国女参议员
zh.s: 1932年1月12日，哈蒂·卡拉韦在阿肯色州的参议员补选中获胜，成为首位经选举产生的美国女参议员。1931年，她先获任填补丈夫去世后留下的席位空缺。这次1月补选与她在1932年稍后赢得完整任期的选举是两次不同的选举。

en.s: The National War Labor Board, commonly the War Labor Board (NWLB or WLB), was an independent agency of the United States government, established January 12, 1942, by an executive order of President Franklin D. Roosevelt, the purpose of which was to mediate labor disputes as part of the American home front during World War II.

zh.t: 美国国家战时劳工委员会成立
zh.s: 1942年1月12日，美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福通过行政命令成立国家战时劳工委员会，通常简称战时劳工委员会。它是美国政府的独立机构，负责调解劳资争议，是美国第二次世界大战后方动员工作的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The Battle of Tarakan took place on 11–12 January 1942, a day after the Empire of Japan declared war on the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Although Tarakan was only a small marshy island off northeastern Borneo in the Netherlands East Indies (today's Indonesia), its 700 oil wells, refineries, and airfield made it a crucial objective for Japan in the Pacific War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1942年1月11日至12日，日本向荷兰宣战后一天，打拉根战役爆发。打拉根是荷属东印度，今印度尼西亚，婆罗洲东北近海的一座沼泽小岛，但岛上的700口油井、炼油厂及机场，使其成为日本在太平洋战争中的重要目标。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The landing at Amchitka on 12 January 1943 was the unopposed amphibious landing operation and occupation of Amchitka island by American forces during the Aleutian Islands campaign during World War II.

zh.s: 1943年1月12日，美军在第二次世界大战阿留申群岛战役期间，对阿姆奇特卡岛实施两栖登陆并占领该岛，整个登陆过程未遭抵抗。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Vistula–Oder offensive (Russian: Висло-Одерская операция, romanized: Vislo–Oderskaya operatsiya) was a Red Army operation on the Eastern Front in the European theatre of World War II in January 1945. The army made a major advance into German-held territory, capturing Kraków, Warsaw, and Poznań. The Red Army had built up their strength around a number of key bridgeheads, with two fronts commanded by Marshal Georgy Zhukov and Marshal Ivan Konev.
en.n: World War II: The Red Army begins the Vistula–Oder Offensive.

zh.s: 维斯瓦河—奥得河攻势是苏联红军于1945年1月在第二次世界大战欧洲东线展开的军事行动。红军大举推进至德军控制区，攻占克拉科夫、华沙和波兹南。此前，红军已在若干重要桥头堡集结兵力，两个方面军分别由格奥尔基·朱可夫元帅和伊万·科涅夫元帅指挥。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战期间，苏联红军开始维斯瓦河—奥得河攻势。

en.t: January 1946 United Nations Security Council election
en.s: The first ever United Nations Security Council elections were held on 12 January 1946 during the 1st session of the United Nations General Assembly, held at Westminster Central Hall in the City of Westminster, London, England, United Kingdom. The elections were for six non-permanent seats on the UN Security Council for two- and one-year mandates commencing immediately upon election, and to expire on January 1st of 1947 and of 1948 upon the assumption of office of successors elected in November 1946 and September 1947, respectively.

zh.t: 1946年1月联合国安理会首次选举
zh.s: 1946年1月12日，第一届联合国大会在英国伦敦威斯敏斯特中央大厅举行期间，进行了安理会史上首次选举，选出六个非常任理事国席位。任期分为一年或两年，当选即就任，分别于1947年及1948年1月1日届满，由1946年11月和1947年9月选出的继任国接任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: Motown is an American record label owned by Universal Music Group. Founded by American record executive Berry Gordy Jr., as Tamla Records on January 12, 1959, it was incorporated as Motown Record Corporation on April 14, 1960. Its name, a portmanteau of motor and town, has become a nickname for Detroit, the center of the automotive industry in the United States, where Motown was originally headquartered.

zh.t: 摩城唱片的前身塔姆拉唱片成立
zh.s: 摩城唱片是一家美国唱片公司，现归环球音乐集团所有。音乐制作人贝里·戈迪于1959年1月12日创立塔姆拉唱片，随后于1960年4月14日注册成立摩城唱片公司。“Motown”由motor与town两词合成，也成为美国汽车工业中心底特律的别称；摩城唱片最初就设在这座城市。

en.s: The Zanzibar Revolution (Swahili: Mapinduzi ya Zanzibar; Arabic: ثورة زنجبار, romanized: Thawrat Zanjibār) began on 12 January 1964 and led to the overthrow of the Sultan of Zanzibar Jamshid bin Abdullah and his mainly Arab government by the island's majority Black African population. Zanzibar was an ethnically diverse state consisting of a number of islands off the east coast of Tanganyika.

zh.s: 1964年1月12日，桑给巴尔革命爆发。岛上占多数的非洲黑人推翻了苏丹贾姆希德·本·阿卜杜拉及其主要由阿拉伯人组成的政府。当时，桑给巴尔是位于坦噶尼喀东海岸外、由若干岛屿组成的多民族国家。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The thirteenth government of Israel was formed by Levi Eshkol on 12 January 1966, following the November 1965 elections. His coalition included the Alignment (an alliance of Mapai and Ahdut HaAvoda), the National Religious Party, Mapam, the Independent Liberals, Poalei Agudat Yisrael, Progress and Development and Cooperation and Brotherhood, and had eighteen ministers.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 以色列第十三届政府成立
zh.s: 1965年11月大选后，列维·艾希科尔于1966年1月12日组建以色列第十三届政府。执政联盟包括工党联盟（由以色列地工人党与劳工团结党组成）、国家宗教党、统一工人党、独立自由党、以色列联盟工人党、“进步与发展”和“合作与兄弟情谊”。本届政府共有18名部长。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: Super Bowl III was an American football championship game played on January 12, 1969, at the Orange Bowl in Miami, Florida. It was the third AFL–NFL Championship Game in professional American football, and the first to officially bear the trademark name "Super Bowl". Super Bowl III is regarded as one of the greatest upsets in both American football history and in the history of professional sports. The 18-point underdog American Football League (AFL) champion New York Jets defeated the National Football League (NFL) champion Baltimore Colts by a score of 16–7.

zh.s: 1969年1月12日，第三届超级碗美式橄榄球冠军赛，在美国佛罗里达州迈阿密的橙碗球场举行。这是第三次美式橄榄球联盟（AFL）与国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）的冠军对决，也是首次正式使用“超级碗”注册名称。赛前被看低18分的AFL冠军纽约喷气机，以16比7击败NFL冠军巴尔的摩小马。这被视为美式橄榄球乃至职业体育史上最著名的冷门之一。

en.t: 1971 Speaker of the British House of Commons election
en.s: The 1971 election of the Speaker of the House of Commons occurred on 12 January 1971, following the retirement of the previous Speaker Horace King. The election resulted in the election of Conservative MP Selwyn Lloyd, formerly Chancellor of the Exchequer and Foreign Secretary. It was the first election with more than one nominee since William Morrison defeated Major James Milner in the 1951 election.

zh.s: 前任议长霍勒斯·金退休后，英国下议院于1971年1月12日举行议长选举，最终选出曾任财政大臣和外交大臣的保守党议员塞尔温·劳埃德。这是自1951年威廉·莫里森击败詹姆斯·米尔纳少校以来，首次有多名候选人竞争的议长选举。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Algeria on 12 January 1984. Incumbent Chadli Bendjedid, leader of the National Liberation Front (the country's sole legal political party), was re-elected unopposed with 99.42% of the vote, based on a 96.28% voter turnout.

zh.s: 1984年1月12日，阿尔及利亚举行总统选举。该国唯一合法政党民族解放阵线的领导人、现任总统沙德利·本·杰迪德，没有竞争对手，以99.42%的得票率连任。投票率为96.28%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Mahbes was fought on 12 January 1985 during the Western Sahara War. As part of its Grand-Maghreb offensive, the Polisario Front, with heavy means (tanks and ground-to-air missiles), broke through the wall of sand defended by the Royal Moroccan armed forces.

zh.s: 1985年1月12日，西撒哈拉战争中的马赫贝斯战役爆发。作为“大马格里布”攻势的一部分，波利萨里奥阵线动用坦克和地对空导弹等重型装备，突破摩洛哥皇家武装部队防守的沙墙。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: STS-61-C was the 24th mission of NASA's Space Shuttle program, and the seventh mission of Space Shuttle Columbia. It was the first time that Columbia, the first space-rated Space Shuttle orbiter to be constructed, had flown since STS-9. The mission launched from Florida's Kennedy Space Center on January 12, 1986, and landed six days later on January 18, 1986.

zh.s: STS-61-C是美国航天飞机计划的第二十四次任务，也是“哥伦比亚号”的第七次飞行。这架首艘具备太空飞行能力的航天飞机，自STS-9之后首次再度执行任务。1986年1月12日，任务从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射升空，六天后于1月18日着陆。

en.s: Presidential elections were held for the first time in Bulgaria on 12 January 1992, with a second round on 19 January. The result was a victory for Zhelyu Zhelev of the Union of Democratic Forces, who won 52.8% of the vote in the second round. Voter turnout was 75.4% in the first round and 75.9% in the second.

zh.s: 1992年1月12日，保加利亚首次举行总统选举，并于1月19日进行第二轮。民主力量联盟的热柳·热列夫，以第二轮52.8%的得票率获胜。第一轮投票率为75.4%，第二轮为75.9%。

en.s: The Brčko Offensive, also known as Operation Corridor '93, was a offensive undertaken by the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS) in early January 1993 with the objective of widening and securing the Posavina Corridor near Brčko. The corridor, which connected western and eastern parts of Republika Srpska, had come under repeated pressure from combined Croatian Defence Council (HVO) and Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (ARBiH) attacks in late 1992.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1993年1月初，塞族共和国军发动布尔奇科攻势，也称“93走廊行动”，旨在拓宽并巩固布尔奇科附近的波萨维纳走廊。这条走廊连接塞族共和国东西两部分，1992年末持续受到克罗地亚防卫委员会与波黑共和国军联合进攻的压力。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On 1 January 1994, the Zapatista Army of National Liberation (EZLN) coordinated a 12-day uprising in the state of Chiapas, Mexico, in protest against the enactment of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA). The rebels occupied cities and towns in Chiapas, releasing prisoners and destroying land records. After battles with the Mexican Army and police, a ceasefire was brokered on 12 January.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1994年1月1日，萨帕塔民族解放军在墨西哥恰帕斯州发动为期12天的起义，抗议《北美自由贸易协定》生效。起义军占领当地城镇，释放囚犯并销毁土地档案。与墨西哥军队和警察交战后，双方于1月12日达成停火。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Space Shuttle Atlantis launched on the STS-81 mission on January 12, 1997, for a visit to the Russian space station Mir. The mission carried Jerry Linenger to the station and returned John Blaha to Earth as part of the Shuttle–Mir crew exchange programme.

zh.s: 1997年1月12日，亚特兰蒂斯号航天飞机执行STS-81任务升空，前往俄罗斯和平号空间站。此次任务将杰里·利嫩杰送上空间站，并将约翰·布拉哈接回地球，完成航天飞机与和平号合作计划中的一次驻站人员轮换。

en.t: Downtown Disney opens to the public as part of the Disneyland Resort in Anaheim, California
en.s: Downtown Disney (officially the Downtown Disney District) is a lifestyle center located at the Disneyland Resort in Anaheim, California, United States. It opened on January 12, 2001; a component of the Disneyland Resort expansion project alongside the Disney California Adventure theme park and Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa.

zh.t: 加州迪士尼小镇向公众开放
zh.s: 迪士尼小镇位于美国加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆的迪士尼度假区，是一处商业休闲街区。它于2001年1月12日开放，与迪士尼加州冒险乐园、迪士尼大加州人酒店及水疗中心一起，构成当时度假区扩建项目的一部分。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Abkhazia on 12 January 2005. The result was a victory for Sergei Bagapsh of United Abkhazia, who received over 90% of the vote.

zh.s: 2005年1月12日，阿布哈兹举行总统选举，统一阿布哈兹组织的谢尔盖·巴加普什以超过90%的选票获胜。

en.t: Launch of the Deep Impact spacecraft
en.s: NASA’s Deep Impact spacecraft launched from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station on January 12, 2005. Its mission was to study the interior of comet Tempel 1 by releasing an impactor. The impactor struck the comet’s nucleus at 05:52 UTC on July 4, 2005, ejecting material from its interior and forming an impact crater.

zh.t: 深度撞击号探测器发射
zh.s: 2005年1月12日，美国国家航空航天局的深度撞击号探测器从卡纳维拉尔角空军基地发射，准备向坦普尔1号彗星释放撞击器，以研究彗星内部的成分。同年7月4日世界协调时05时52分，撞击器击中彗核，抛出内部物质并形成撞击坑。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Taiwan on 12 January 2008 to elect the members of the Legislative Yuan. It was the first Legislative Yuan election after the constitutional amendments of 2005, which extended term length from three to four years, reduced seat count from 225 to 113, and introduced the current electoral system.

zh.s: 2008年1月12日，台湾举行立法委员选举。这是2005年修宪后的首次立委选举：任期从三年延长至四年，席位由225席减少为113席，并开始采用现行选举制度。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in Malta on 12 January 2009. Former Labour Party deputy leader George Abela was elected to become the next President of Malta on 4 April 2009, when the incumbent Eddie Fenech Adami steps down; this marks the first time that a member of the opposition was elected president, as the Nationalist Party controlled the legislature.

zh.s: 2009年1月12日，马耳他举行间接总统选举，前工党副领袖乔治·阿贝拉当选，定于4月4日接替卸任总统埃迪·费内克·阿达米。当时国民党掌控议会，因此这是首次选出反对党成员担任总统。

en.s: The 2010 Haiti earthquake (French: Séisme de 2010 à Haïti; Haitian Creole: Tranblemanntè 12 janvye 2010 nan peyi Ayiti) was a catastrophic magnitude 7.0 Mw earthquake, with an epicenter near the town of Léogâne (Ouest), approximately 25 kilometres (16 mi) west of Port-au-Prince, Haiti's capital. The earthquake occurred at 16:53 local time (21:53 UTC) on Tuesday, 12 January 2010. By 24 January, at least 52 aftershocks measuring 4.5 or greater had been recorded. An estimated three million people were affected by the quake. Death toll estimates range from 100,000 to about 160,000 to Haitian government figures from 220,000 to 316,000 that have been widely characterized as deliberately inflated by the Haitian government.

zh.s: 2010年1月12日星期二当地时间16时53分，即协调世界时21时53分，海地发生矩震级7.0级的破坏性地震。震中位于西部省莱奥甘附近，在首都太子港以西约25公里。截至1月24日，至少记录到52次4.5级及以上余震，估计有300万人受到影响。死亡人数估计差异很大，有估计为10万至约16万人；海地政府公布的数字则为22万至31.6万人，但这一官方统计被广泛认为遭到政府刻意夸大。

en.s: El Protector (2012) was the first annual El Protector professional wrestling event produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group. It took place on January 12, 2012, at Arena Naucalpan in Naucalpan, State of Mexico. The 2012 El Protector was the first event produced under that name, but was a continuation of the Proyeccion a Nuevas Promesas ("Projecting a new promise") tournament of 2010 and 2011 . The focal point of the show was the El Protector tag team tournament where eight teams competed for the trophy.

zh.s: 2012年1月12日，国际摔角革命集团在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场，举办首届年度“保护者”职业摔角赛事。虽然首次采用这一名称，它延续了2010年和2011年的“新秀展望”锦标赛。重点项目是“保护者”组队锦标赛，共八支队伍争夺奖杯。

en.s: Strikeforce: Marquardt vs. Saffiedine was a mixed martial arts event held by Strikeforce. The event took place on January 12, 2013 at the Chesapeake Energy Arena in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The event aired live on Showtime.

zh.s: 2013年1月12日，Strikeforce在美国俄克拉何马城的切萨皮克能源竞技场，举办综合格斗赛事“马夸特对阵萨菲丁”，由Showtime现场直播。

en.t: TNA One Night Only: X-Travaganza recording
en.s: TNA recorded One Night Only: X-Travaganza at the Impact Zone in Orlando, Florida, on January 12, 2013. The professional wrestling event brought together past and present X-Division performers and featured Jerry Lynn’s final TNA match. The programme later aired on pay-per-view on April 5, 2013.

zh.s: 2013年1月12日，TNA在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact Zone场馆录制“单夜特别赛X-Travaganza”。这场职业摔角赛事汇集X组别的历届及现役选手，并安排了杰里·林恩在TNA的最后一场比赛。节目后来于2013年4月5日通过按次付费电视播出。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Czech Republic in January 2013, the country's first direct election for the presidency. No candidate received a majority of the votes in the first round on 11–12 January, so a second round runoff election was held on 25–26 January. Nine individuals secured enough signatures or support of parliamentarians to become official candidates for the office.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 捷克于2013年1月举行首次总统直选，共有9人获得足够的选民签名或议员支持，成为正式候选人。1月11日至12日的首轮投票无人获得过半数选票，因此于1月25日至26日举行第二轮决选。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的首轮投票日期。

en.s: On 12 January 2015, militants from Boko Haram attacked a Cameroonian military base in Kolofata, Far North Region, Cameroon. The raid was unsuccessful, and over 100 Boko Haram fighters were killed.

zh.s: 2015年1月12日，博科圣地武装袭击喀麦隆极北大区科洛法塔的一座军营。袭击未能得手，100多名博科圣地武装人员被打死。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: On 12 January 2016, a suicide attack in Istanbul's historic Sultanahmet district killed 13 people, all foreigners, and injured 14 others. The attack occurred at 10:20 local time, near the Blue Mosque and the Hagia Sophia, an area popular among tourists. The attacker was Nabil Fadli (Arabic: نبيل فضلي), a Syrian member of the Islamic State.

zh.s: 2016年1月12日，土耳其伊斯坦布尔历史悠久的苏丹艾哈迈德区发生自杀式袭击，造成13人死亡、14人受伤，死者均为外国人。袭击发生于当地时间上午10时20分，地点靠近蓝色清真寺和圣索菲亚大教堂，是游客密集区域。袭击者为叙利亚籍“伊斯兰国”成员纳比勒·法德利。

en.s: On January 12, 2016, two United States Navy riverine command boats were seized by the naval forces of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps after entering Iranian territorial waters near Farsi Island in the Persian Gulf. The United States initially attributed the incident to mechanical failure, but it was later reported that navigational errors had led the boats into Iranian waters.

zh.s: 2016年1月12日，美国海军两艘河岸指挥艇进入波斯湾法尔西岛附近的伊朗领海后，被伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队海军扣押。美方起初将误入领海归因于机械故障，后有报道指出，舰艇是因导航错误进入伊朗水域。

en.s: La Copa Junior (2016) (Spanish for "The Junior Cup") was a professional wrestling tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council"). The tournament ran from January 5, 2016 to January 19, 2016 in Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. CMLL's recurring La Copa Junior tournament featured second, third or fourth generation wrestlers completing against each other.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2016年1月5日至19日，墨西哥世界摔角理事会（CMLL）在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场策划并举办“二代杯”（La Copa Junior）职业摔角锦标赛。西班牙语名称意为“后辈杯”。这是CMLL定期举办的赛事，参赛者均为摔角世家的第二、第三或第四代选手。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的赛事日期。

en.s: Crossroads was a special episode of Impact! produced by Impact Wrestling, which took place on January 12, 2018, at the Impact Zone in Orlando, Florida and aired on March 8, 2018. Five professional wrestling matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Austin Aries successfully defended the World Championship against Johnny Impact.

zh.t: Impact Wrestling“十字路口”特别节目
zh.s: 2018年1月12日，Impact Wrestling在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact Zone制作《Impact!》特别一期“十字路口”，于3月8日播出。赛事共五场，压轴赛中奥斯汀·阿里斯击败约翰尼·Impact，成功卫冕世界冠军。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 2018 Egyptian Super Cup (also known as the 2017–18 SAIB Egyptian Super Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the 15th edition of the Egyptian Super Cup, an annual football match between the winners of the previous season's Egyptian Premier League and Egypt Cup. The match is usually contested by the winners of the Premier League and the Egypt Cup, but since Al Ahly won the double (2016–17 Egyptian Premier League and 2016–17 Egypt Cup), Al Masry qualified by default as the runners-up of the cup.

zh.s: 2018年埃及超级杯因赞助冠名亦称“2017—2018赛季SAIB埃及超级杯”，是第15届埃及超级杯。这项年度足球赛事通常由上赛季埃及足球甲级联赛冠军与埃及杯冠军交锋。由于开罗国民队包揽2016—2017赛季联赛和埃及杯冠军，埃及杯亚军马斯里队递补获得参赛资格。

en.s: Legacy Fighting Alliance 30: Millender vs. Barnes took place on January 12, 2018, and aired on AXS TV. The event was held at Costa Mesa Hall at the OC Fair & Event Center in California, United States.

zh.s: 2018年1月12日，Legacy Fighting Alliance举办“LFA 30：米伦德对阵巴恩斯”，并通过AXS TV播出。赛事地点是美国加利福尼亚州橙县展览与活动中心的科斯塔梅萨大厅。

en.s: On January 12, 2019, militants from the Chadian rebel group Military Command Council for the Salvation of the Republic (CCMSR) skirmished with Sudanese rebels from the Justice and Equality Movement (JEM).

zh.s: 2019年1月12日，乍得叛乱组织“拯救共和国军事指挥委员会”的武装人员，与苏丹“正义与平等运动”叛军发生小规模交火。

en.s: Uncaged was a professional wrestling television special produced by Impact Wrestling, which was taped on January 11 and January 12, 2019 at the Frontón México in Mexico City, Mexico and it aired on February 15, 2019 as an episode of Impact!. Four professional wrestling matches were contested at the event. The main event was a four-way match for the Impact World Championship, in which Johnny Impact retained the title against Brian Cage, Killer Kross and Moose.

zh.t: Impact Wrestling“挣脱牢笼”特别节目
zh.s: 2019年1月11日至12日，Impact Wrestling在墨西哥城的Frontón México录制职业摔角电视特别节目“挣脱牢笼”，于2月15日作为《Impact!》的一期播出。赛事共进行四场比赛。压轴赛为Impact世界冠军四人争夺战，约翰尼·Impact击败布赖恩·凯奇、Killer Kross和Moose，成功卫冕。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: NXT UK TakeOver: Blackpool II was a 2020 professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by the American promotion WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's United Kingdom-based developmental brand, NXT UK. It was the third and final NXT UK TakeOver event, the second annual and final TakeOver: Blackpool, and the final livestreaming event produced exclusively for NXT UK. The event took place on Sunday, January 12, 2020, at the Empress Ballroom in Blackpool, Lancashire, England, the same venue as the first TakeOver: Blackpool.

zh.s: 2020年1月12日星期日，WWE在英格兰兰开夏郡黑池的皇后舞厅，举办“NXT UK TakeOver：黑池II”网络直播职业摔角赛事，仅由英国培养品牌NXT UK的选手参加。场馆与首届黑池赛事相同。这是第三场也是最后一场NXT UK TakeOver，第二届也是最后一届TakeOver黑池赛事，同时也是最后一场专为NXT UK制作的网络直播赛事。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 2020 Hard To Kill was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Impact Wrestling. It took place on January 12, 2020, in Dallas, Texas. It was the inaugural event under the Hard To Kill chronology. Nine matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Tessa Blanchard defeated Sami Callihan in an intergender match to win the Impact World Championship, becoming the first female world champion in Impact history.

zh.s: 2020年1月12日，Impact Wrestling在美国得克萨斯州达拉斯举办首届“难以击倒”按次付费职业摔角赛。赛事共九场，压轴赛中，泰莎·布兰查德在男女混合对决中击败萨米·卡利汉，赢得Impact世界冠军，成为该组织历史上首位女性世界冠军。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 2020 Supercopa de España final decided the winner of the 2020 Supercopa de España, the 36th edition of the annual Spanish football super cup competition. The match was played on 12 January 2020 at King Abdullah Sports City in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The final featured city rivals Real Madrid and Atlético Madrid. Real Madrid won the match 4–1 on penalties, following a 0–0 draw after extra time, to win their 11th Supercopa title.

zh.s: 2020年1月12日，第36届西班牙超级杯决赛在沙特阿拉伯吉达的阿卜杜拉国王体育城举行，由同城对手皇家马德里与马德里竞技争冠。双方加时赛后仍为0比0，皇家马德里在点球大战中以4比1获胜，第11次夺得超级杯。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 2021 Supercoppa Italiana (branded as the Supercoppa Frecciarossa for sponsorship reasons) was the 34th edition of the Supercoppa Italiana. It was played between Inter Milan, winners of the 2020–21 Serie A championship, and Juventus, winners of the 2020–21 Coppa Italia. On 11 November 2021, it was announced that the match would be played on 12 January 2022 at San Siro, Milan.

zh.s: 2021年意大利超级杯因赞助冠名亦称“红箭意大利超级杯”，是第34届意大利超级杯，由2020—2021赛季意甲冠军国际米兰对阵同赛季意大利杯冠军尤文图斯。赛事于2021年11月11日宣布，比赛将在2022年1月12日于米兰圣西罗球场举行。

en.t: 2023 Speaker of the Koshi Provincial Assembly election
en.s: The 2023 Speaker of the Koshi Provincial Assembly election was held on January 12, 2023, to elect the speaker of the Koshi Provincial Assembly. However nominations have been fixed for the election from 3pm to 5pm and CPN (Maoist Centre), politician Baburam Gautam who had been nominated in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution, was the only candidate to file the nomination for the post.

zh.t: 2023年尼泊尔戈希省议会议长选举
zh.s: 2023年1月12日，尼泊尔戈希省议会举行议长选举。候选人提名时间定在下午3时至5时，按宪法规定获得提名的尼泊尔共产党（毛主义中心）政治人物巴布拉姆·高塔姆，是唯一提交申请的候选人。

en.s: The 2023 Oksibil attacks were conducted by the separatist West Papua National Liberation Army (TPNPB) periodically on Oksibil, the seat of Bintang Mountains Regency, Highland Papua from 7 January to 12 January 2023. According to the Regional Police of Papua, the Bintang Mountains is one of 7 regencies that are vulnerable to separatist attacks.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2023年1月7日至12日，分离主义组织西巴布亚民族解放军多次袭击印度尼西亚高地巴布亚省宾唐山县首府奥克西比尔。据巴布亚地方警方介绍，宾唐山县是7个容易遭到分离主义袭击的县之一。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Between 12 January 2024 and 6 May 2025 the United States and the United Kingdom, with support from Australia, Bahrain, Canada, Denmark, the Netherlands, and New Zealand, launched a series of cruise missile and airstrikes against the Houthi movement in Yemen in response to Houthi attacks on ships in the Red Sea.

zh.s: 2024年1月12日至2025年5月6日，美国与英国在澳大利亚、巴林、加拿大、丹麦、荷兰及新西兰支持下，对也门胡塞武装发动一系列巡航导弹打击和空袭，回应胡塞武装在红海袭击船只。

en.t: ONE Friday Fights 47: Suakim vs. Balyko
en.s: ONE Friday Fights 47: Suakim vs. Balyko, also known as ONE Lumpinee 47, was a combat sports event produced by ONE Championship. It took place on January 12, 2024, at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand.

zh.t: ONE周五格斗夜47：苏金对阵巴雷科
zh.s: 2024年1月12日，ONE冠军赛在泰国曼谷伦披尼拳击场举办“ONE周五格斗夜47：苏金对阵巴雷科”。这场搏击赛事亦称“ONE伦披尼47”。

en.s: LFA 174: Jones vs. Gennrich was a mixed martial arts event promoted by Legacy Fighting Alliance. It took place on January 12, 2024, at Mystic Lake Casino Hotel in Prior Lake, Minnesota, United States, and aired on UFC Fight Pass.

zh.s: 2024年1月12日，Legacy Fighting Alliance在美国明尼苏达州普赖尔莱克的神秘湖赌场酒店举办综合格斗赛事“LFA 174：琼斯对阵根里奇”。赛事通过UFC Fight Pass播出。

en.s: The 2025 Supercopa de España final was a football match that decided the winner of the 2025 Supercopa de España, the 41st edition of the annual Spanish football super cup competition. The match was played on 12 January 2025 at the King Abdullah Sports City in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

zh.s: 2025年1月12日，第41届年度西班牙超级杯决赛，在沙特阿拉伯吉达的阿卜杜拉国王体育城举行，决出本届冠军。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Croatia on 29 December 2024, with a second round held on 12 January 2025 after no candidate received a majority of the vote in the first round. Incumbent president Zoran Milanović was eligible for a second term, and was re-elected with a record 75% of the vote.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克罗地亚于2024年12月29日举行总统选举。由于首轮无人获得过半数选票，第二轮投票于2025年1月12日举行。现任总统佐兰·米拉诺维奇有资格竞选第二个任期，最终以创纪录的75%得票率获连任。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: The 2025 Super Copa Grão-Pará was the 2nd Super Copa Grão-Pará, a football match played between the winners of the previous season's Campeonato Paraense and Copa Grão-Pará competitions. The match was contested between Paysandu and Tuna Luso. Paysandu defeated Tuna Luso 2–0 for their 1st Super Copa Grão-Pará title.

zh.s: 2025年大帕拉超级杯是第二届大帕拉超级杯，由上赛季帕拉州足球锦标赛冠军与大帕拉杯冠军争夺。本届比赛由派桑杜对阵图纳卢索。派桑杜以2比0获胜，首次夺得大帕拉超级杯冠军。
